label_definitions.VERIFIED: Read directly on a primary source (CMS, Medicare.gov, SSA/POMS, IRS, DOL, HHS, NJ DOBI, NJ SHIP, Get Covered NJ), or 2+ independent originating sources.
label_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Some evidence, but the primary page was not opened or does not state it directly. Always carries a confidence.
label_definitions.INFERRED: Derived from VERIFIED facts by stated arithmetic or reasoning. Always carries a confidence and the derivation.
label_definitions.ASSUMED: Taken without evidence; must be confirmed by the user or a named office.
label_definitions.PENDING: Official figure not yet published as of meta.as_of. Show the projection only if labeled as a projection.

meta.display_rule: Every number or rule shown in the app must reference a fact id below. The UI shows the label badge, confidence (if any), and a link to source.url. Facts past review_after show a 'may be out of date' banner.
